name: dclint
description: Installs the dclint Dockerfile Compose linter from GitHub releases.

dclintVersion.description: dclint version to install (without the leading v)

sha256Amd64.description: SHA-256 of the dclint amd64 binary for the selected version (required on amd64)

sha256Arm64.description: SHA-256 of the dclint arm64 binary for the selected version (required on arm64)
